newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Analysts cheer SAirGroup operating result.
newsitem.headline: Analysts cheer SAirGroup operating result.

text.p: A 40 percent boost in SAirGroup's 1996 operating profit gave industry analysts a positive surprise and will trigger some upward revisions of profit forecasts.
"I am positively surprised and bullish," said Dieter Winet of Societe Generale Bank and Trust.

SAirGroup, the newly-created holding company that includes the Swissair airline, boosted operating profit to 344 million Swiss francs from 247 million, but extraordinary charges of 567 million pushed it into a larger-than-expected net loss of 497 million.
